cues.zh: 把孩子和洗澡水一起倒掉。
cues.en: the baby with the bathwater.
And I look at, on your show, actually,
I kind of lost my voice,
and I haven't gotten it back.
I'm hoping that by talking to you
I'm going to get it back.

cues.zh: CR：要是能做点什么，我一定帮。
cues.en: CR: If I could do anything, I would do that.

cues.zh: LP：好。那就拿出你的巫毒娃娃
cues.en: LP: All right. So get out your voodoo doll
and whatever you need to do.

cues.zh: 但我觉得，你知道吗，我看着这件事，
cues.en: But I think, you know what, I look at that,
I made that public,

cues.zh: 然后收到了所有这些信息。
cues.en: and I got all this information.

cues.zh: 我们做了一项关于医疗状况的调查
cues.en: We got a survey done on medical conditions

cues.zh: 对象是有类似问题的人，
cues.en: with people who have similar issues,
and I look at medical records, and I say,
wouldn't it be amazing

cues.zh: 如果每个人的医疗记录都能获取
cues.en: if everyone's medical records were available
anonymously
to research doctors?

cues.zh: 当有人访问你的医疗记录时，
cues.en: And when someone accesses your medical record,
a research doctor,

cues.zh: 他们能看到，你能看到哪位医生
cues.en: they could see, you could see which doctor
accessed it and why,
and you could maybe learn about
what conditions you have.
I think if we just did that,

cues.zh: 今年就能挽救10万条生命。
cues.en: we'd save 100,000 lives this year.
CR: Absolutely. Let me go — (Applause)
LP: So I guess I'm just very worried that
with Internet privacy,

cues.zh: 我们正在重蹈医疗记录的覆辙，
cues.en: we're doing the same thing we're doing with medical records,

cues.zh: 把洗澡水和孩子一起倒掉，
cues.en: is we're throwing out the baby with the bathwater,
and we're not really thinking
about the tremendous good that can come
from people sharing information

cues.zh: 以正确的方式分享给正确的人。
cues.en: with the right people in the right ways.
CR: And the necessary condition
that people have to have confidence

cues.zh: 他们的信息不会被滥用。
cues.en: that their information will not be abused.

cues.zh: LP：是的，我的声音数据就遇到了这个问题。
cues.en: LP: Yeah, and I had this problem with my voice stuff.
I was scared to share it.
Sergey encouraged me to do that,
and it was a great thing to do.
CR: And the response has been overwhelming.

cues.zh: LP：是啊，大家反响特别积极。
cues.en: LP: Yeah, and people are super positive.

cues.zh: 我们收到了成千上万的人
cues.en: We got thousands and thousands of people
with similar conditions,

cues.zh: 而目前这些还没有数据。
cues.en: which there's no data on today.
So it was a really good thing.

cues.zh: CR：那聊聊未来，是什么让你
cues.en: CR: So talking about the future, what is it about you
and transportation systems?

cues.zh: LP：嗯，我想我当年在密歇根上大学时
cues.en: LP: Yeah. I guess I was just frustrated
with this when I was at college in Michigan.
I had to get on the bus and take it
and wait for it.
And it was cold and snowing.

cues.zh: 我研究了一下这要花多少钱，
cues.en: I did some research on how much it cost,

cues.zh: 然后就有点迷上交通系统了。
cues.en: and I just became a bit obsessed with transportation systems.

cues.zh: CR：这就催生了自动驾驶汽车的想法。
cues.en: CR: And that began the idea of an automated car.
LP: Yeah, about 18 years ago I learned about

cues.zh: 有人在研究自动驾驶汽车，
cues.en: people working on automated cars,
and I became fascinated by that,

cues.zh: 这些项目要启动得花些时间，
cues.en: and it takes a while to get these projects going,

cues.zh: 但我对它能改善世界的可能性
cues.en: but I'm super excited about the possibilities of that
improving the world.

cues.zh: 每年有两千万人以上受伤。
cues.en: There's 20 million people or more injured per year.
It's the leading cause of death
for people under 34 in the U.S.

cues.zh: CR：所以你说的是拯救生命。
cues.en: CR: So you're talking about saving lives.
LP: Yeah, and also saving space
and making life better.

cues.zh: 洛杉矶一半是停车场和道路，
cues.en: Los Angeles is half parking lots and roads,
half of the area,

cues.zh: 其实大多数城市也好不到哪去。
cues.en: and most cities are not far behind, actually.
It's just crazy

cues.zh: 我们竟然把空间用在这些地方。
cues.en: that that's what we use our space for.
CR: And how soon will we be there?

cues.zh: LP：我觉得很快，非常快就能实现。
cues.en: LP: I think we can be there very, very soon.

cues.zh: 我们已经行驶了远超10万英里，
cues.en: We've driven well over 100,000 miles
now totally automated.

cues.zh: 我非常期待尽快把它推向市场。
cues.en: I'm super excited about getting that out quickly.

cues.zh: CR：但你不只是在谈自动驾驶汽车。
cues.en: CR: But it's not only you're talking about automated cars.

cues.zh: 你还有关于自行车的想法。
cues.en: You also have this idea for bicycles.
LP: Well at Google, we got this idea

cues.zh: 就是给所有人提供免费自行车，
cues.en: that we should just provide free bikes to everyone,

cues.zh: 效果非常棒，大多数出行都靠它。
cues.en: and that's been amazing, most of the trips.
You see bikes going everywhere,
and the bikes wear out.

cues.zh: 它们一天24小时都在被使用。
cues.en: They're getting used 24 hours a day.

cues.zh: CR：但你也想把它们放到街道上方。
cues.en: CR: But you want to put them above the street, too.
LP: Well I said, how do we get people
using bikes more?

cues.zh: CR：我们这里可能有段视频。
cues.en: CR: We may have a video here.
LP: Yeah, let's show the video.
I just got excited about this.
(Music)

cues.zh: 所以这其实就是如何以最低成本
cues.en: So this is actually how you might separate
bikes from cars with minimal cost.
Anyway, it looks totally crazy,

cues.zh: 但我其实在想我们的校园，
cues.en: but I was actually thinking about our campus,
working with the Zippies and stuff,

cues.zh: 就是想大幅提高自行车使用率，
cues.en: and just trying to get a lot more bike usage,
and I was thinking about,
how do you cost-effectively separate
the bikes from traffic?
And I went and searched,
and this is what I found.

cues.zh: 我们其实并没有在做这个，
cues.en: And we're not actually working on this,
that particular thing,

cues.zh: 但它能激发你的想象力。
cues.en: but it gets your imagination going.
CR: Let me close with this.

cues.zh: 请谈谈你自己思维中的哲学。
cues.en: Give me a sense of the philosophy of your own mind.

cues.zh: 你有关于 Google X 的这个理念。
cues.en: You have this idea of [Google X].
You don't simply want

cues.zh: 进入某个小而可衡量的进步领域。
cues.en: to go in some small, measurable arena of progress.
LP: Yeah, I think

cues.zh: 我们刚才谈到的很多事情都是这样，
cues.en: many of the things we just talked about are like that,
where they're really --

cues.zh: 我几乎要用经济学中“额外性”的概念，
cues.en: I almost use the economic concept of additionality,
which means that you're doing something

cues.zh: 除非你真的在做，否则它不会发生。
cues.en: that wouldn't happen unless you were actually doing it.

cues.zh: 我觉得你越能做这样的事，
cues.en: And I think the more you can do things like that,
the bigger impact you have,
and that's about doing things

cues.zh: 人们可能认为不可能的事。
cues.en: that people might not think are possible.
And I've been amazed,
the more I learn about technology,

cues.zh: 就越意识到自己不知道的越多，
cues.en: the more I realize I don't know,

cues.zh: 这是因为技术的地平线，
cues.en: and that's because this technological horizon,

cues.zh: 你能看到下一步要做的事，
cues.en: the thing that you can see to do next,
the more you learn about technology,

cues.zh: 就越了解什么是可能的。
cues.en: the more you learn what's possible.

cues.zh: 你了解到气球是可以实现的
cues.en: You learn that the balloons are possible

cues.zh: 因为有些材料能派上用场。
cues.en: because there's some material that will work for them.

cues.zh: CR：不过对我来说，你身上有意思的一点是，
cues.en: CR: What's interesting about you too, though, for me,
is that, we have lots of people
who are thinking about the future,
and they are going and looking and they're coming back,

cues.zh: 但我们始终看不到实现过程。
cues.en: but we never see the implementation.

cues.zh: 我会想到一个你认识的人，
cues.en: I think of somebody you knew
and read about, Tesla.

cues.zh: 对你来说，这背后的原则是什么？
cues.en: The principle of that for you is what?

cues.zh: LP：嗯，我认为光有发明是不够的。
cues.en: LP: Well, I think invention is not enough.

cues.zh: 如果你发明了什么东西，
cues.en: If you invent something,

cues.zh: 特斯拉发明了我们使用的电力，
cues.en: Tesla invented electric power that we use,

cues.zh: 但他很难把它推广给大众。
cues.en: but he struggled to get it out to people.
That had to be done by other people.
It took a long time.

cues.zh: 我认为如果我们真能把这两件事结合起来，
cues.en: And I think if we can actually combine both things,

cues.zh: 既有对创新和发明的专注，
cues.en: where we have an innovation and invention focus,

cues.zh: 又有一家公司具备真正……
cues.en: plus the ability to really -- a company

cues.zh: 能够真正将事物商业化
cues.en: that can really commercialize things
and get them to people
in a way that's positive for the world
and to give people hope.

cues.zh: 你知道，Loon项目让我很惊讶
cues.en: You know, I'm amazed with the Loon Project
just how excited people were about that,
because it gave them hope

cues.zh: 为世界上三分之二的人
cues.en: for the two thirds of the world

cues.zh: 那些现在还没有良好互联网的人。
cues.en: that doesn't have Internet right now that's any good.

cues.zh: CR：这是关于公司的第二点。
cues.en: CR: Which is a second thing about corporations.
You are one of those people who believe

cues.zh: 公司是变革推动者的人之一
cues.en: that corporations are an agent of change
if they are run well.
LP: Yeah. I'm really dismayed

cues.zh: 大多数人认为公司基本上是邪恶的。
cues.en: most people think companies are basically evil.
They get a bad rap.
And I think that's somewhat correct.

cues.zh: 公司在做同样的渐进式改变
cues.en: Companies are doing the same incremental thing
that they did 50 years ago
or 20 years ago.

cues.zh: 那不是我们真正需要的。
cues.en: That's not really what we need.

cues.zh: 我们需要，特别是在技术领域，
cues.en: We need, especially in technology,

cues.zh: 我们需要革命性的变化，
cues.en: we need revolutionary change,
not incremental change.
CR: You once said, actually,
as I think I've got this about right,
that you might consider,
rather than giving your money,

cues.zh: 如果你要留给某个事业，
cues.en: if you were leaving it to some cause,
just simply giving it to Elon Musk,
because you had confidence
that he would change the future,
and that you would therefore —
LP: Yeah, if you want to go Mars,
he wants to go to Mars,
to back up humanity,

cues.zh: 那是值得的目标，但它是公司，
cues.en: that's a worthy goal, but it's a company,
and it's philanthropical.

cues.zh: 我觉得我们想做的事挺类似的。
cues.en: So I think we aim to do kind of similar things.

cues.zh: 你问的这个，我觉得，我们有很多员工
cues.en: And I think, you ask, we have a lot of employees

cues.zh: 在 Google 已经相当富有了。
cues.en: at Google who have become pretty wealthy.
People make a lot of money in technology.

cues.zh: 在座很多人也相当有钱。
cues.en: A lot of people in the room are pretty wealthy.

cues.zh: 你工作是因为你想改变世界。
cues.en: You're working because you want to change the world.
You want to make it better.
Why isn't the company that you work for

cues.zh: 凭什么不只值得你付出时间，
cues.en: worthy not just of your time
but your money as well?
I mean, but we don't have a concept of that.

cues.zh: 我们不是这样看待公司的，
cues.en: That's not how we think about companies,
and I think it's sad,

cues.zh: 因为公司占据了我们大部分的心力。
cues.en: because companies are most of our effort.

cues.zh: 人们大部分时间都在公司里，
cues.en: They're where most of people's time is,
where a lot of the money is,

cues.zh: 所以我觉得，我希望我们能多出一份力，
cues.en: and so I think I'd like for us to help out
more than we are.
CR: When I close conversations with lots of people,
I always ask this question:
What state of mind,
what quality of mind is it
that has served you best?

cues.zh: 鲁珀特·默多克这样的人说是好奇心，
cues.en: People like Rupert Murdoch have said curiosity,

cues.zh: 媒体界的其他人也这么说过。
cues.en: and other people in the media have said that.

cues.zh: 比尔·盖茨和沃伦·巴菲特说是专注。
cues.en: Bill Gates and Warren Buffett have said focus.
What quality of mind,

cues.zh: 在我即将离开这个舞台之际，
cues.en: as I leave this audience,
has enabled you to think about the future
and at the same time
change the present?

cues.zh: LP：你知道，我认为最重要的一点——
cues.en: LP: You know, I think the most important thing --
I looked at lots of companies

cues.zh: 思考它们为何无法长久成功。
cues.en: and why I thought they don't succeed over time.

cues.zh: 公司的更替速度越来越快。
cues.en: We've had a more rapid turnover of companies.

cues.zh: 我就问，它们根本上做错了什么？
cues.en: And I said, what did they fundamentally do wrong?

cues.zh: 那些公司都做错了什么？
cues.en: What did those companies all do wrong?

cues.zh: 通常就是它们错过了未来。
cues.en: And usually it's just that they missed the future.
And so I think, for me,

cues.zh: 我就是努力聚焦于此，然后问，
cues.en: I just try to focus on that and say,

cues.zh: 那个未来究竟会是什么样，
cues.en: what is that future really going to be
and how do we create it,

cues.zh: 以及如何让我们的组织，
cues.en: and how do we cause our organization,
to really focus on that

cues.zh: 并以极高的速度去推动它？
cues.en: and drive that at a really high rate?
And so that's been curiosity,
it's been looking at things

cues.zh: 人们可能不会去想的事情，
cues.en: people might not think about,
working on things that no one else is working on,

cues.zh: 因为真正的增量价值就在那里，
cues.en: because that's where the additionality really is,
and be willing to do that,
to take that risk.
Look at Android.

cues.zh: 当初 Android 刚起步时，
cues.en: I felt guilty about working on Android
when it was starting.

cues.zh: 那是我们收购的一个小创业公司。
cues.en: It was a little startup we bought.

cues.zh: 它并不是我们真正在做的事。
cues.en: It wasn't really what we were really working on.

cues.zh: 我为自己在那上面花时间感到内疚。
cues.en: And I felt guilty about spending time on that.
That was stupid.
That was the future, right?
That was a good thing to be working on.
CR: It is great to see you here.
It's great to hear from you,

cues.zh: 也很荣幸能和你同坐这张桌子。
cues.en: and a pleasure to sit at this table with you.
Thanks, Larry.
LP: Thank you.
(Applause)
CR: Larry Page.
